_meta.purpose: Panel/component bundling edits. If a provider bills the panel AND its component tests separately for the same date, the components are double-billed.
_meta.note: These are well-known laboratory panel definitions, included so the engine is testable out of the box. Production deployments should load the full CMS National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) Procedure-to-Procedure edit file. See docs/reference-data.md.

panels.name: Complete blood count with automated differential

mutually_exclusive.reason: Same-day admit-and-discharge service already includes the discharge; a separate discharge management code on the same date is duplicative.
85025 is the complete blood count with differential; 85027 is the same count without it. Both on one day for one draw is duplicative.

incidental.reason: Routine venipuncture is frequently billed alongside the lab work it collected for. It is separately payable only once per encounter, so multiple venipuncture lines on one date are worth challenging.
